Interface constants

Source: R/aaa_constants.R
interface_constants.Rd

Upstream's command line messages (SCENE_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE and so on, with {} where upstream formats in a scene name), the help epilog and context settings, the key codes of Shift and Ctrl used by interactive scenes, the default window position (START_X, START_Y), and RendererType, the values the renderer setting accepts.

Usage

SCENE_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE

CHOOSE_NUMBER_MESSAGE

INVALID_NUMBER_MESSAGE

NO_SCENE_MESSAGE

EPILOG

CONTEXT_SETTINGS

SHIFT_VALUE

CTRL_VALUE

START_X

START_Y

RendererType

Format

Strings, numbers, or named lists.

Value

Character strings and numbers used by the command line and the interactive window. CONTEXT_SETTINGS and RendererType are named lists.
